top3_reasons.label: C02
top3_reasons.reason: L51 stores the raw CharSequence (StringBuffer) as a HashMap key, and StringBuffer lacks content-based equals/hashCode, so lookups never match; the fix is to key on seq[0].toString().

top3_reasons.label: C01
top3_reasons.reason: L77 looks up the subSequence directly in lookupMap, so it fails because the map keys are StringBuffers; this method is the symptom site rather than the root cause, though converting subSeq to a String here would be part of the fix.
